nurse.text: Hiya! Welcome to Dundee Sanctuary. Sit yourself down, your team looks like it walked over the Tay Road Bridge into the wind. Which it did.
What can we do for you?

then.text: There's tea, and a slice of Dundee cake with the almonds on top. Never cherries. Don't let anybody tell you cherries.
There you go, right as rain. In Dundee that's a very high standard of right.
The Ark's over there. Have a click.

else.text: Nae bother. Mind how you go, and say hello to the dolphins.
